title: All dimpled cheeks and curls, Your head it simply swirls.
html_source:
A slightly mistaken chorus from the song Seaside Girls mentioned in Milly’s letter above.

Those girls, those girls, those lovely seaside girls,
All dimples, smiles, and curls — your head it simply whirls!
